mechanism.mechanism_of_action: SGLT2 inhibitor that blocks glucose reabsorption in the renal proximal tubule, promoting urinary glucose excretion and improving glycemic control and heart/kidney outcomes

clinical.indications: Type 2 diabetes, heart failure (reduced ejection fraction), chronic kidney disease, pediatric type 2 diabetes

market.market_position: Leading SGLT2 inhibitor, approved in 126+ countries, blockbuster status [uncertain]
